stem: These sentences help the reader understand that Big Bird's caretakers —

options.label: F
options.text: lack the resources to give Big Bird what he needs

options.label: G
options.text: know that Big Bird belongs in the wild

options.label: H
options.text: believe that Big Bird will get lost if he flies away

options.label: J
options.text: are trying to find out where Big Bird came from

visual_elements: Everyone at the resort anticipated that Big Bird would fly away and rejoin his flock once he regained his health. (paragraph 4)
He may one day take flight, find a flock of pelicans to join, and never return to the place where he learned to fly. (paragraph 7)
